response_format.header: Live ТБ · снимок {snapshot_time_msk} МСК · линии {odds_time_msk} МСК
response_format.funnel: Пул {raw} → окно {in_window} → новых {new} → с динамикой {with_trend} → сильных {strong} → выбор {selected}.
match_lines: {number}. [ранг {sports_rank}] {home_ru} - {away_ru} ({league_ru}, {category_ru}) | {score}, {minute}′ {period} | уверенность: сильная | основной ТБ {main_line} × {main_price_text}; справочно вниз: {rounded_down_text}; ещё {additional_goals}; {push_condition} | {redcards_and_material_discrepancies} | ГП: {home_mean_total}/{away_mean_total}/{league_mean_total} (N={home_n}/{away_n}/{league_n}).

research_hypotheses.display: Append matched labels only: Г1/Г2/Г3. No match does not exclude a candidate.

user_total_policy.calculation: Use the exact provider main total and its quoted over price, including quarter lines.
user_total_policy.quarter_display: Also show line minus 0.25 as a convenience reference only.
user_total_policy.rounded_price: Never attach or transfer a price to the convenience reference line.
user_total_policy.missing_reference: н/д; do not invent a line.
user_total_policy.selection_effect: None; prices never affect sporting rank.

response_format.footer: Уверенность: {confidence}/100 в данных снимка, не вероятность гола.
rules: ONLY one short final answer, 0-5 strong candidates; no preliminary list or automatic full cards.
Full cards and exclusion reasons only on подробно, without a new live request.
Keep goal profile means and N compact; do not invent missing values.
Show red cards, material discrepancies, goals needed and integer-line push condition.
No Olimp availability checks and no additional exact-price verification.
Keep existing reference-line collection; missing exact price is проверить, not an admission veto.
Confidence describes evidence, never a calibrated win probability or a guaranteed outcome.
Zero choices: time, funnel, Подходящих матчей нет. API failure is not an empty pool.
Record only the actual final choices as a small .github/live-publications/<snapshot_id>.json receipt; commit with GitHub create_file, never rewrite the large legacy ledger through the connector.
Do not delay the ready final answer for formatting, extra checks or registry persistence.
